pages.text: Eight uranium ingots ringed around a whole Block of Uranium. The label reads $(thing)Uranium Arc Reactor$(); everyone who builds one calls it dirty.

pages.title: This Is Fine
pages.text: It's an arc reactor core rebuilt around an OreSpawn uranium slug, and it slots into Marvel's suit-upgrading bench anywhere the diamond arc reactor used to go. Palladium nearly killed Tony. This is fine.$(p)Getting your hands on one signs the $(thing)This Is Fine$() advancement — and no, it has no EMC. That's policy; see $(l:orespawn_integrations:always_uranium/uranium_economy)The Uranium Economy$().

pages.title: Three Suits, One Slug
pages.text: With the Marvel mod loaded, three suit-upgrade recipes accept the dirty core at the upgrading bench.$(p)$(thing)Mark 11$() — bring a Mark 7 chestplate, plus three gold-titanium ingots, two gold ingots, one iron ingot, one redstone dust, and the reactor.

pages.title: ...and the Other Two
pages.text: $(thing)Mark 15$() — a Mark 11 chestplate, plus four titanium ingots, two iron ingots, one redstone dust, one tinted glass, and the reactor.$(p)$(thing)Mark 17$() — a Mark 15 chestplate, plus two gold-titanium ingots, three gold ingots, one iron ingot, a whole block of redstone, and the reactor.$(p)Same suits Marvel always sold. The power bill just switched fuels.
